scope: Publication and cloud handoff only. No new training or optimization run.
primary_metric: Mean across all original business bags of sum per leg(goal_arrival - first_planning_attempt); retry time included; EBS storage excluded.
secondary_metrics: fraction with final goal arrival <= STD
fraction with final goal arrival <= STD - 2700 seconds
STD_is: Input delivery deadline; not the standard deviation of transport time.
hard_constraints: Directed-edge entry separation at least 2 seconds
Do not preempt confirmed node/edge reservations
Complete continuous-motion certificate required before admission

versions.023: Absolute-deadline source-attempt priority: negative Nanning1x result
versions.024: Nonexpired-first source-attempt priority: negative Nanning1x result

execution: User requested future training on a cloud environment. This publication does not provision cloud compute or claim training has started.
comparison_requirements: Compare with well-tuned deterministic G31 and equal-compute deeper lookahead

Separate training and independent demand evaluation
Report THT first and both deadline measures separately

distributed_boundary: Current simulation is serial. Local scoring plus complete route certificates is not a verified device-level distributed transaction protocol.
